project_unitInterval.statement: theorem project_unitInterval (z : ℝ) : project unitInterval z = min (max z 0) 1

square_regular.statement: theorem square_regular (y : ℝ) : RegularLoss unitInterval (fun x : ℝ => (x-y)^2)

gradient_square.statement: theorem gradient_square (y x : ℝ) : gradient (fun x : ℝ => (x-y)^2) x = 2 * (x-y)

gradient_square_bound.statement: theorem gradient_square_bound (y x : ℝ) (hy : y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hx : x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : ‖gradient (fun x : ℝ => (x-y)^2) x‖ ≤ 2

square_step_clamp.statement: theorem square_step_clamp (η y x : ℝ) : step unitInterval η (fun x : ℝ => (x-y)^2) x = min (max (x - 2 * η * (x-y)) 0) 1

example_2_14.statement: theorem example_2_14 (y : ℕ → ℝ) (x0 : ℝ) (hx0 : x0 ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) (hy : ∀ t < T, y t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : ∀ u ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, regret unitInterval (1 / (2 * Real.sqrt T)) (fun t x => (x-y t)^2) x0 u T ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt T

guessing_zero_trajectory.statement: theorem guessing_zero_trajectory (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (t : ℕ) : iterate unitInterval (1/(4*(n:ℝ))) (fun _ x => (x-0)^2) 1 t = (1 - 1/(2*(n:ℝ)))^t

guessing_squared_horizon_lower.statement: theorem guessing_squared_horizon_lower (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : (n:ℝ)/4 ≤ regret unitInterval (1/(2*Real.sqrt (((2*n)^2 : ℕ) : ℝ))) (fun _ x => (x-0)^2) 1 0 ((2*n)^2)

meanPredict_zero_cumulativeLoss.statement:
theorem meanPredict_zero_cumulativeLoss (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) :
    (∑ t ∈ range T,
      (BanditRL.OnlineLearning.meanPredict (fun _ : ℕ => (0 : ℝ)) t)^2) = 1/4

guessing_vs_mean_lower.statement:
theorem guessing_vs_mean_lower (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (n : ℝ)/4 - 1/4 ≤
      regret unitInterval (1/(2*Real.sqrt (((2*n)^2 : ℕ) : ℝ)))
        (fun _ x => (x-0)^2) 1 0 ((2*n)^2) -
      (∑ t ∈ range ((2*n)^2),
        (BanditRL.OnlineLearning.meanPredict (fun _ : ℕ => (0 : ℝ)) t)^2)

guessing_vs_mean_unbounded.statement:
theorem guessing_vs_mean_unbounded (C : ℝ) (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, N < n ∧
      C < regret unitInterval (1/(2*Real.sqrt (((2*n)^2 : ℕ) : ℝ)))
        (fun _ x => (x-0)^2) 1 0 ((2*n)^2) -
      (∑ t ∈ range ((2*n)^2),
        (BanditRL.OnlineLearning.meanPredict (fun _ : ℕ => (0 : ℝ)) t)^2)
